Phase 43 implementation — cockpit hardening, a legible cycle. Branch phase-43-cockpit-hardening @ f341913 (PR to follow). gate: see entry @ f341913.

What changed, where:
- tagteam/cockpit_api.py — Phase 43 read model: OUTCOMES + normalize_outcome; activity_payload() (in-flight marker + usage + conversation_turns + gates + panels + non-succeeded launches → newest first, running first; ids `turn:<stem>` for stem-bearing turns so the running row and its later record are ONE row, else `<source>:<rowid>`; server-side dedupe, terminal record wins; a launch that reached its lead turn is shown as that conversation row); last_turn(); launch_view() (effective status derived from the lead turn / owner liveness; failed only within 24 h and for the current intent); now_payload gains turn_kind / launch / last_turn; events_signature adds conversation_turns + launches digests and in-flight log growth in LOG_SIGNAL_STEP (8 KiB) steps; turn_log_path() (stem validated, strictly under turns dir); tail_payload(stem=).
- tagteam/server.py — GET /api/activity[?limit]; GET /api/activity/log/<stem>/events (SSE over .tagteam/turns/<stem>.log: `line` per complete line with id = byte offset, Last-Event-ID / ?after= replay, a final partial line flushed once the marker is gone, `end` when no marker names the stem and the file is drained; 400 bad stem, 404 unknown); _stream_sse() shared poller — lead_sse now rides it (ids/replay/end/heartbeat/--max-sse identical); /api/tail?stem=.
- tagteam/data/web/cockpit.html|js|css — Cycle region (#cycle: Lead/Reviewer lanes, token on the owed side, running lane pulses, kind named, status line with last outcome) + Activity log (#activity: rows keyed by id, patched never wiped; running row streams via the log SSE or the shared conversation stream; finished rows stay with OUTCOME_LABEL status, duration, [log]/[transcript]; [cancel] on the running row → cancel-turn / lead cancel; a running row whose record vanishes is marked orphaned); Start → starting state from now.launch (Start card suppressed while pending, back with the failure when failed); #chip-inflight names the kind, new #chip-last; tail drawer + btn-tail removed; Lead panel keeps streamed lines (LEAD.lines) — live box refilled on re-render, finished turn shows `activity (N lines)` <details>; gate line names the cycle turn ("<agent> is on its cycle turn (round N) — see Cycle activity"); shared buffered EventSource registry (one connection per resource, late joiners get the replay); region shown when phase ∨ pending launch ∨ in-flight ∨ any activity.
- docs — how-tagteam-works #cockpit (Cycle region + Activity, outcome vocabulary, endpoints) and #lead (nothing collapses); README cockpit section + cockpit-cycle.png; docs/cockpit-issues.md 2026-08-16 entry marked resolved; docs/media/README.md manifest; plan doc "Implementation notes (impl round 1)" lists every deviation.
- scripts/showcase_seed.py — demo-web gets a running reviewer turn (detached sleep as the live pid, growing log, gate pass, three finished turns).
- tests/test_cockpit_activity.py (new, 46 tests) — vocabulary, every source + normalisation, marker merge / dedupe / same-id record, cap, last_turn, now keys, launch_view (pending→turn, failed recent+current intent, orphaned), signature sources + bounded cost, tail?stem= + traversal, /api/activity + legacy 404, log SSE (stream, live follow, partial-line hold/flush, end, Last-Event-ID replay, :end cursor, finished stem, 400/404, cap counts), lead SSE on the shared poller, JS/HTML/CSS source guards (no innerHTML in the Phase 43 block, ids present, tail gone, OUTCOME_LABEL exactly seven). tests/test_docs_story.py registers the screenshot.

Verified: focused runs green while working; manual Playwright walk (1280×800) recorded in the plan doc — running reviewer turn streams; turn ended cancelled and finished → same row patched with lines kept incl. the final partial line; Start → starting → ok (Start card gone/back, Lead panel keeps activity (4 lines)); reload persistence. Full suite: the gate on this submission.

No schema bump, no CLI change, saloon/hub untouched. Scoping: saloon rethink is Phase 44 (approved in the plan round).

GATE: PASS | scope 13 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1392 passed, 5 skipped, 4m15s)
